svg.title: Shapes and brushes: where meets what in BuildingTool.fill
svg.desc: A shape is a mask that selects cells and a brush is a rule that assigns material. BuildingTool.fill visits every selected cell, asks the brush for a block, and writes a filled schematic; swap the shape or brush to see the result change.

g.aria-label: The shape tells fill where to place blocks
The brush tells fill what block each cell gets
fill writes the composed blocks into a schematic

g.title: Shape
g.desc: A mask that selects cells and says nothing about material.

g.title: Brush
g.desc: Two blocks alternate row by row.

text.tspan: Two blocks alternate row by row.

g.title: BuildingTool.fill
g.desc: Shape decides where, brush decides what.

g.title: Filled schematic
g.desc: The composed build: one block per selected cell.
